proposal: Plant to operate and meet emission limits over 44.2-50.0 MJ/kg (the Wobbe range 47.2-51.8 is within the combustion system capability); performance guarantees remain at the reference gas.
question: ER-03.02 requires operation for LHV 45.0-50.0 MJ/kg; ALP-OWN-FUL-001 shows 44.2 MJ/kg for 3 % of hours (high N2/CO2 gas). Must the plant operate, and meet guarantees and emissions, below 45.0 MJ/kg?
response: Accepted. The plant shall operate and meet the emission limits for LHV 44.2-50.0 MJ/kg; performance guarantees apply at the reference gas with corrections per the agreed curves.
subject: Gas LHV range: 45.0 MJ/kg (contract) vs 44.2 MJ/kg (network data)
